body:
## Which Ninja Double Stack should you buy?

The Double Stack is Ninja's answer to the problem with dual-drawer air fryers: they take up a lot of worktop. Instead of two drawers side by side, it stacks them on top of each other, so it's narrower than a Dual Zone of similar capacity. Each drawer also takes a rack, so you can cook on four levels at once. As with the Dual Zone, the two drawers run independently and can be set to finish together.

There are two main UK models, and the spec differences are small:

- **Double Stack SL300UK (7.6L):** two drawers, two racks, six functions (including Air Fry, Max Crisp and Bake), 2,270W. Ninja pitches it for families of up to six. **Best for most households.**
- **Double Stack XL SL400UK (9.5L):** the same design with more space and 2,470W, aimed at batch cooking for up to eight. It's available in black, grey, white and silver depending on the retailer.

For two to four people, the 7.6L is plenty. Two chicken breasts in one drawer and chips in the other is well within its capacity. The XL earns its place if you regularly cook whole meals for five or more, or batch cook at the weekend. At today's prices the gap between them is only £10, which makes the XL the better buy if you have the depth on your worktop for it.

If you'd rather have side-by-side drawers or one big drawer for a whole chicken, see our [air fryer Black Friday deals guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/), which covers the Dual Zone and FlexDrawer models too.

## What's a good price?

PriceSpy's three-month data gives a clear picture:

- **SL300UK 7.6L:** ranged from £152.99 to £199.99 over the last three months. **£169 is good; £155 or less is a great price** and the one to hold out for in Black Friday week.
- **SL400UK XL 9.5L:** ranged from £179 to about £218 over the same period, so **£179 is the lowest it has been in three months.** Anything at or under £179 is worth buying.

Ignore big "was" prices. Argos shows the XL with a crossed-out £270, but nobody has charged that recently, so the real saving is closer to £40. Currys had the white XL at £229.99 in late October, which shows how much prices vary by colour and retailer, so check a couple of shops before you buy.

## When do Ninja Double Stack prices drop?

Ninja air fryers are cut for every big sale: Black Friday (27 November 2026), Amazon's Prime Day in July and the January sales. Prices are already falling this month, and the 7.6L's three-month low of £152.99 suggests there's another £15 or so to come. The XL is already at its low, so there's less reason to wait.

Amazon's Black Friday prices sometimes need Prime. If you don't have it, you can time a [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) to cover the sale and cancel afterwards. Our [Amazon Prime free trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how.

## Things to know before you buy

**Check the height and depth.** Stacking saves width but the XL is tall, and you need space above it for steam. Measure under your wall cupboards.

**The racks matter.** The extra racks are how you get four levels. Cooking on the rack is best for flat things like fish fillets, bacon or toast, and less good for anything that needs shaking.

**Running costs are low.** Like any air fryer, it heats a small space quickly, so it usually costs less to run than a full oven for a small meal.

For more Ninja deals, see our [Ninja Black Friday deals guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Ninja Creami deals](/guides/ninja-creami-deals-uk/), or browse [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).

### Is the Ninja Double Stack better than the Dual Zone?

It does the same job in a narrower footprint, with extra racks for four-level cooking. Choose the Double Stack if worktop width is tight; choose a Dual Zone if you want lower, wider drawers that are easier to see into and shake.

### What's the difference between the SL300UK and SL400UK?

Size and power. The SL300UK is 7.6L and 2,270W; the SL400UK XL is 9.5L and 2,470W. Both have two drawers, two racks and six functions.

### How much is the Ninja Double Stack on Black Friday?

We expect the 7.6L to drop to around £150 to £155 and the XL to stay at about £179 or a little lower. We'll update this guide as Black Friday prices appear.

### Is the Ninja Double Stack dishwasher safe?

Ninja and the retailers list the drawers and racks as dishwasher safe. Hand-washing will help the non-stick coating last longer.

### Where is the Ninja Double Stack cheapest?

Today, Amazon, AO and Very have the 7.6L at £169, and Amazon and Very have the XL at £179. Argos is a penny under £170 and £180 respectively.
